profile.reading:
This facility, "T-Mobile Warszawa-Szlachecka," is associated with T-Mobile Polska, the Polish mobile and fixed telecommunications operator that is part of Deutsche Telekom's international group, located in the Szlachecka district of Warsaw. The prior record for this facility carried no operator name; this registry corrects that gap directly based on the facility's own name and T-Mobile Polska's well-established corporate identity as a Deutsche Telekom subsidiary.

The Szlachecka area of Warsaw is associated with telecommunications infrastructure in general Warsaw-area context, though this registry's research this session could not independently confirm whether this specific site functions as a full-scale IT data center, a mobile switching center, or another category of telecom technical facility -- these categories are related but distinct, and OSM tagging with telecom=data_center does not always distinguish them precisely. As a national mobile and fixed-line operator, T-Mobile Polska operates a range of network and IT infrastructure across Poland that is not typically individually marketed or documented at the building level in public sources.

No specific IT capacity in megawatts, technical square footage, or year-opened date for this facility was found in sourcing available this session. This registry separately tracks another T-Mobile Polska facility elsewhere in Warsaw; whether these two OpenStreetMap records represent genuinely distinct sites or reflect two different mappings of related T-Mobile Polska network infrastructure in the Warsaw area has not been independently confirmed this session.
